title: Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning Research and Development Engineer

cond_0001.intro:
The Cyber Innovation, Analytics & Operations Department within the Communications, Information and Navigation Office (CINO) at the Applied Research Laboratory (ARL) is looking for talented, experienced Data Scientists to assist in providing its customers with state-of-the-art solutions. In this position you will research, develop, and deliver algorithmic, machine learning, and artificial intelligence based approaches to solve complex sponsor problems.
The selected candidates will assume a technical role and will interact with other ARL staff and sponsors, spending a majority of the time working in a classified environment in [Location masked]. Periodic travel to sponsor sites may be required.
[Company name masked] is an authorized DoD SkillBridge partner and welcomes all transitioning military members to apply.
This position can be filled at multiple levels, depending upon your education and experience. Minimally requires a Bachelor's degree in an Engineering or Science discipline. Additional experience and/or education are required for higher level jobs. A Master's degree is preferred.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
You will:
Design, develop, and research machine learning systems, models, and schemes
Study, transform, and apply state-of-the-art machine learning prototypes to sponsor specific domains collection and data modeling
Visualize data for deeper insights
Generate and present technical research reports and briefings
Performing statistical analysis in support of pattern of life and anomaly detection
Build high quality software prototypes integrated with our various research and pre-production software environments
Additional responsibilities of higher level positions include:
Supervise the work of lower level staff and undergraduate student
Perform tasks of a larger scope and lead specific tasks within the project scope
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Data science/algorithm development
Data science / Machine Learning languages to include Python
Research, development and implementation of machine learning models
Statistics, linear algebra, and data structures
Exploratory data analysis and visualization
Active TS/SCI Clearance
U.S. Citizenship (candidates selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must complete a pre-employment drug screen)
Preferred Requirements
Training and optimizing ML algorithms on GPU hardware architectures, specifically NVIDIA based
Data science / Machine Learning tools to include Pandas, PyTorch/TensorFlow, NumPy, MatPlotLib, SQL, FastAPI
Software Development tools to include Git, Docker, Kubernetes, SSH

In this position you will research, develop, and deliver algorithmic, machine learning, and artificial intelligence based approaches to solve complex sponsor problems.
The selected candidates will assume a technical role and will interact with other ARL staff and sponsors, spending a majority of the time working in a classified environment in [Location masked]. Periodic travel to sponsor sites may be required.

Design, develop, and research machine learning systems, models, and schemes

Performing statistical analysis in support of pattern of life and anomaly detection

Perform tasks of a larger scope and lead specific tasks within the project scope

Data science/algorithm development

Statistics, linear algebra, and data structures
Exploratory data analysis and visualization
Data science / Machine Learning tools to include Pandas, PyTorch/TensorFlow, NumPy, MatPlotLib, SQL, FastAPI
Software Development tools to include Git, Docker, Kubernetes, SSH
Active TS/SCI Clearance
Candidates selected will be subject to a government security investigation. You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply. Employment with the Applied Research Laboratory will require successful completion of a pre-employment drug screen.
